title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.18747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. translated_title: 视频即体验：通过音视频理解学习计算机操作
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（LLMs）已催生出强大的计算机操作智能体，它们能够感知图形用户界面、对指令进行推理并执行操作。然而，现有的从视频演示中学习的方法通常将视频转换为基于截图的动作轨迹，而非直接利用视频丰富的音视频信息。我们提出了VEX（Video as EXperience，视频即体验），这是一个利用音视频理解来统一“从外部演示学习”与“反思智能体自身行为”的框架。遵循“观看-行动-重看”范式，智能体从包含视觉演示和口头讲解的教程视频中提取程序性指导，执行任务，并通过以视频形式重看自己的执行过程来验证任务进展。我们使用video-SALMONN-VEX对该框架进行了实例化，这是一个基于video-SALMONN 2架构构建、采用Qwen3.5-9B骨干网络的9B规模音视频计算机操作智能体。
tldr: 该论文提出VEX框架，让计算机操作智能体直接从包含视觉演示和语音讲解的教程视频中学习，并以视频形式重看自身执行过程进行验证，形成“观看-行动-重看”的音视频学习范式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VEX, a framework that enables computer-use agents to learn directly from audio-visual tutorial videos with spoken explanations and verify their own task execution by rewatching it as video, following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm.
